test_title: PYST 61: RRB Group D - Reasoning (Held On: 24 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the pair that follows the same pattern as that followed by the two pairs given below. Both pairs follow the same pattern.

YAB−XZA

TVW−SUV
solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/019b67a6af4f42362880ba6d0f7728e0ff899c56fca27e0fd190cf1f1320ca91.png] Logic followed here is: Each letter in the first group is shifted backward by one position (-1) in the alphabetical series to obtain the corresponding letter in the second group. **For YAB − XZA →**
